The anomaly detection is incorrectly expecting the Image URL to be in .jpg/.svg format. For this retailer, the extracted Image URL is expected to use the .res resource format, so the .res URL should be considered valid and the .jpg/.svg format should not be treated as the expected value.

This is a false positive. The bullet points are present in the page DOM, but they are inside a collapsed accordion element, so they are not visible in the screenshot. A bullet point that is hidden in the screenshot should not be treated as missing or mismatched when it is present in the DOM. The suggested bullet points are not valid bullet points: they contain no bullet symbol or list markup (such as •, -, or <li>) and read as a continuous description paragraph. Text that looks like a description should not be treated as bulletPoints.

This is a false positive. The GTIN is not visible in the screenshot, but it is present in the page DOM, inside the script[type="application/ld+json"] structured data. The extracted GTIN comes from that structured data and is correct for the main product. A value that is missing from the screenshot but present in the page's structured data should not be flagged as an extraction error.
